---
title: Colors
description: "JK-UI color system: shadcn-standard tokens, theme modes, and CSS variables."
---

JK-UI uses **shadcn-standard CSS variable names** consumed through Tailwind v4 `@theme` utilities. All color values are semantic tokens, never hardcoded.

## Prerequisites

Make sure `jk-ui-cli setup` has run and generated your `jk-ui-theme.css`. This file defines the CSS variables and `@theme inline` mappings for your chosen theme.

## Token Reference

### shadcn-Standard Tokens

| Variable | Light (`:root`) | Dark (`.dark`) | Tailwind Class |
|----------|----------------|----------------|----------------|
| `--background` | `--color-white` | `--color-gray-950` | `bg-background` |
| `--foreground` | `--color-gray-700` | `--color-gray-300` | `text-foreground` |
| `--card` | `--color-white` | `--color-gray-950` | `bg-card` |
| `--card-foreground` | `--color-gray-900` | `--color-white` | `text-card-foreground` |
| `--popover` | `--color-white` | `--color-gray-950` | `bg-popover` |
| `--popover-foreground` | `--color-gray-700` | `--color-gray-300` | `text-popover-foreground` |
| `--primary` | `--color-primary-600` | `--color-primary-500` | `bg-primary` |
| `--primary-foreground` | `--color-white` | `--color-white` | `text-primary-foreground` |
| `--secondary` | `--color-secondary-600` | `--color-secondary-500` | `bg-secondary` |
| `--secondary-foreground` | `--color-white` | `--color-white` | `text-secondary-foreground` |
| `--muted` | `--color-gray-100` | `--color-gray-900` | `bg-muted` |
| `--muted-foreground` | `--color-gray-600` | `--color-gray-400` | `text-muted-foreground` |
| `--accent` | `--color-accent-600` | `--color-accent-500` | `bg-accent` |
| `--accent-foreground` | `--color-white` | `--color-white` | `text-accent-foreground` |
| `--destructive` | `--color-danger-600` | `--color-danger-500` | `bg-destructive` |
| `--destructive-foreground` | `--color-white` | `--color-white` | `text-destructive-foreground` |
| `--border` | `--color-gray-200` | `--color-gray-800` | `border-border` |
| `--input` | `--color-gray-200` | `--color-gray-700` | `border-input` |
| `--ring` | `--color-primary-600` | `--color-primary-500` | `ring-ring` |

### Extended jk-ui Tokens

| Variable | Light | Dark | Tailwind Class |
|----------|-------|------|----------------|
| `--fg-title` | `--color-gray-900` | `--color-white` | `text-fg-title` |
| `--bg` | `--background` | `--background` | `bg-bg` |
| `--bg-subtle` | `--muted` | `--muted` | `bg-bg-subtle` |
| `--bg-surface` | `--color-gray-50` | `--alpha(var(--color-gray-900)/70%)` | `bg-bg-surface` |
| `--bg-muted` | `--color-gray-200` | `--color-gray-800` | `bg-bg-muted` |
| `--border-strong` | `--color-gray-300` | `--color-gray-700` | `border-border-strong` |
| `--border-card` | `--border` | `--border` | `border-border-card` |
| `--danger` | `--destructive` | `--destructive` | `text-danger` / `bg-danger` |

## Theme Modes

JK-UI supports choosing your color scheme during setup:

| Mode | Description |
|------|-------------|
| `both` | Full light and dark variable sets. Recommended. |
| `light` | Light mode only. |
| `dark` | Dark mode only. |

The `jk-ui-cli setup` command prompts you to choose and generates the appropriate CSS.

## @theme Registration

Tokens are registered in `@theme inline` so Tailwind generates the utility classes:

```css
@theme inline {
  --color-background: var(--background);
  --color-foreground: var(--foreground);
  --color-primary: var(--primary);
  --color-muted: var(--muted);
  --color-muted-foreground: var(--muted-foreground);
  --color-border: var(--border);
  --color-input: var(--input);
  --color-ring: var(--ring);
  --radius: var(--radius);
  /* extended tokens */
  --color-fg-title: var(--fg-title);
  --color-bg-subtle: var(--bg-subtle);
}
```

Once registered, use `bg-background`, `text-foreground`, `border-input`, `ring-ring`, etc. throughout the UI.
